req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-007 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a new unique squad_number returns 201 Created, (2) a negative/EP case confirming a duplicate squad_number returns exactly 409 Conflict with the correct detail message, (3) a boundary/STC case confirming the state transition from first-create (201) to second-create-same-squad (409) is deterministic, (4) a DT case confirming a different squad_number after a 409 still succeeds with 201, and (5) a BVA case using the lowest existing squad_number (1) to confirm boundary duplicates are caught. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, exact status code assertions, and exact response body checks to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99 (not in DB)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99, and a valid UUID id
trace: R-PLAYER-007: positive path — unique squad_number must succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_same_squad_number_twice_state_transition_201_then_409
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 50 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=50 (first call — should create)
POST /players/ with squad_number=50 again (second call — should conflict)
expected: Second POST detail equals 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-007: state transition — non-existent -> created (201) -> duplicate (409)

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_different_name_still_returns_409
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad number 5 (Vivaan Nair)
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=5 but completely different first_name and last_name
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict (exactly — conflict is on squad_number, not on name)
Response body detail equals 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-007: DT — conflict detection is keyed on squad_number only, regardless of other fields
